descriptions: The {MACGUFFIN} pulses in your hand as you enter {LOCATION}. It unlocked something.
A {CHARACTER} steps out of the shadows. 'You have it,' they say. 'That changes things.'

commands.look: The {MACGUFFIN} glows faintly. The {CHARACTER} watches. North leads on.
commands.talk to {CHARACTER}: '{MACGUFFIN}... I thought it was lost. We may have a chance.' They step aside.
commands.use {MACGUFFIN}: You activate the {MACGUFFIN}. A passage opens to the east.
